properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 24 at 2:15PM EDT by NWS Albany NY
properties.description: The Mohawk River at Schenectady is expected to rise above flood stage this evening. Minor flooding of riverside parks is expected.
properties.instruction: Turn around, don't drown. Move to higher ground if flooding is observed.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 24 at 3:02PM EDT by NWS Albany NY
properties.description: A severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was located near Rotterdam, moving east at 35 mph.
properties.instruction: Take shelter now in a basement or interior room on the lowest floor.

properties.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 24 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Albany NY
properties.description: Heat index values up to 97 expected this afternoon.
